sections.h: Как это устроено (из описания в коде)
p: Phone authentication: one pairing token -> server-side session (HttpOnly cookie) + CSRF token.

The pairing token lives in «локальный путь скрыт» (created on first start). Sessions are kept as SHA-256 of their id in sessions.json, so a copy of that file does not log anyone in. Failed logins are limited per client and globally (sliding minute window); the limit is checked BEFORE the token is compared.
